lines: Amane ran, while nursing her wounded body.
（Those two are nothing alike, and you could even say they're opposites. So, why......?）
Fuuma Kotarou, the boy she had just parted ways with, and his father, Danjou.
Before she knew it, both their faces were overlapping in Amane's mind.
A memory of her talking with Danjou, when she was just a girl.
『If in the future――Well, this is just the worst-case scenario, but...』
『――Amane. If anything should happen, such as me being defeated, don't do anything hasty, all right?』
Amane had received fighting lessons from him.
This memory was a scene from a break during that training.
『......With all due respect, I can't follow that order.』
『If the worst were to happen to Lord-sama, Amane would die with him.』
『Hahahahaha!! The girl's being cheeky! ――Well, I'm also glad I have such a loyal subject.』
“Well, that's why I have to go out of my way to say this, though,” Danjou laughed amusedly.
『Unfortunately, I don't wish for something like that in the slightest.』
『I wouldn't be happy to have a kid like you go right along with me, after all.』
Seeing her looking sullen, he said, as if it had suddenly occurred to him,
『But, if you're going to say that no matter what...... Stick with Kotarou.』
His son and heir, Kotarou, was a child famed for his quick-witted intelligence.
However, Danjou rarely showed him anything that resembled affection, and it was somewhat unusual for his name to come up here.
『Yes, well. It's only in case. It probably won't mean much. But despite what you might think, that boy is surprisingly...... Kukuku.』
Despite being perplexed by her master's odd way of speaking, she quietly nodded.
『If Kotarou-sama is a worthy man to be head of the clan, Amane will gladly give her life for him.』
『But if that is not the case...... Amane will be with Lord-sama until the end.』
『Kuku, you're a stubborn one. In that event, do as you like――』
（――Whether or not that boy has the same capacity to be the family head as Danjou-sama.）
（Well, I don't even have to think about it.）
To Amane, Danjou was one of a kind.
There was no one who could take his place.
For some reason, she was relieved.
She had been able to keep that boy away from danger.
This would end without her dragging him into her own ugly struggle.
Why did that fact make her feel so――
「There she is!! Surround the fox woman!!」
Countless figures flickered between the trees as if running alongside Amane.
――The Fuuma Rogue Ninja Faction main army.
They must have sensed that she wasn't in the hidden mansion, and come chasing after her.
Right now, strangely, she felt like going all out, to the limit of her strength.
「All right, bring it on, lowlives! Let's make this a glorious death!」
